product_metadata.title: HOHIYA 7 Feet Wrought Iron Christmas Tree Metal Ornament Display Stand Holder Hanger Wire Hanging Spiral for Halloween Glass Balls Decorations Gift 174 Hooks Craft Black
features: Wrought iron christmas tree ornament display stand showcase your christmas ornaments and with this distinctive wrought iron metal christmas tree. Sturdy metal branches on the ornament display stand support christmas ornaments without bending or sagging.

Prefectly sized to display your christmas baubles, the HOHIYA metal wrought iron christmas tree ornament display stand have 174 ornament hooks, measures 84”H when fully assembled and 33”W. Spread festival holiday cheer all throughout your home.
The wrought iron christmas tree ornament display stand exceptional stability from the sturdy iron base lets you share cherished christmas ornaments with confidence.
Multifuctional large wrought iron christmas tree ornament display stand can be used year-round at home, shop or commercially.

The wrought iron christmas tree sturdy and heavy ornament display stand is assembled about 10~15 mins with screwdriver and you can adjust height of each branch location.The ornament tree display stand boasts long-lasting welds as well as a rust-resistant finish that complements your glass ornaments and christmas bauble on your Wrought Iron Christmas Display Tree.
